Using the post-increase survey, I computed each restaurant's share of full-time employees (full-time divided by full-time plus part-time) and averaged it within each state. Here, NJ means all four NJ locations combined.

- NJ: 0.320
- PA: 0.272

The difference (NJ − PA) is about 0.048. NJ restaurants have a slightly higher proportion of full-time employees.

If you instead pool all employees in each state before taking the share, you get 0.314 for NJ and 0.290 for PA, a difference of 0.024. I used the per-restaurant average because it is the usual way to answer this question.

ANSWER: 0.048
